application-cleanup-scope.quote: Each of six route-disposed samples requires no iframe/URL/pending fetch/RAF, no active or sourced orphan Audio, and no growing observer/timeout count relative to the first equivalent disposed sample. Wrappers retain numeric handles/stack strings and WeakRefs, not target DOM nodes. WeakRef counts are sampled after diagnostic GC; dereferencing itself affects that job's liveness. The observer instrumentation stores numeric metadata and cannot prove the lifetime of every browser-native observer. ResizeObserver is instrumented where available; no separately observed active ResizeObserver is invented.
